rules.cancellation_rebooking: If a flight is cancelled by the airline, customer is entitled to free rebooking on the next available flight within 24 hours, or a full refund, customer's choice.
rules.delay_more_than_5h: meal voucher + hotel accommodation, covering only the delayed hours (not a full night's stay)
rules.refund: Airline-caused cancellation refunds are processed in full within 7 business days to the original payment method only.
rules.fare_difference: Voluntary higher-fare rebooking requires fare difference. Agents cannot waive fare differences above ₹1,500 without supervisor approval.
rules.loyalty: Gold and Platinum receive priority rebooking (first access to next-available seats), but no additional compensation beyond standard policy.

allowed_actions: Rebook on next available flight within 24 hours at no charge for airline-caused cancellation
Issue meal vouchers and lounge access per delay policy
Arrange hotel accommodation for the delayed-hours portion when qualified
Initiate refund request for airline-caused cancellation
Provide customer's own booking and flight status information
escalation_actions: Threats of legal action or formal complaints
Refund to a different payment method
